A college sophomore and an elderly woman were talking together about risk-taking, specifically focusing on risky behavior like starting fights. The college sophomore never gets into fights and avoids them at all costs, while the elderly woman ends up in fights pretty often, and is usually the one who started it. Who is more risk-averse?
A. Not enough information
B. The elderly woman
C. The college sophomore
